name: Alpsws FAQ Accordion
author: alpsws

sections.description:
Alpsws FAQ Accordion helps you create beautiful, responsive Frequently Asked Questions for your WordPress website. Organize FAQs into categories, display them anywhere using shortcodes, and improve user experience with an accessible accordion layout.

Whether you run an online store, business website, documentation portal, or support center, Alpsws FAQ Accordion makes it easy to present answers in a clean, professional format.

Perfect for:

  • Product FAQs
  • Help Center
  • Knowledge Base
  • Documentation
  • Support Pages
  • Company FAQs

Key Benefits:

  • Responsive accordion layout
  • FAQ Custom Post Type
  • FAQ Categories
  • Shortcode support
  • Gutenberg compatible
  • FAQ Schema support
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Easy customization
  • Mobile friendly
  • Developer friendly

Why Use Alpsws FAQ Accordion?

Instead of displaying long pages of questions and answers, Alpsws FAQ Accordion organizes content into collapsible sections that are easier to read and navigate.

The plugin is lightweight, easy to configure, and designed to work with modern WordPress themes.

Useful Links

PRO Version: https://alpsws.co.in/product/alpsws-faq-accordion/
Documentation: https://alpsws.co.in/docs-faq/
Support: https://alpsws.co.in/contact/

Features

  • Unlimited FAQs
  • FAQ Categories
  • Responsive accordion design
  • FAQ Schema (JSON-LD)
  • Shortcode support
  • Gutenberg support
  • Custom colors
  • Custom icons
  • Animation support
  • Lightweight performance
  • Translation ready
  • Theme compatible
  • Developer friendly

Usage

Display all FAQs

[alpsws_faq]

Display FAQs from a category

[alpsws_faq category=”general”]

Gutenberg Block

Search for:

inside the WordPress block editor to insert your FAQ section.

Settings

Configure the plugin under:

FAQs → Settings

Available options include:

  • Primary Color
  • Border Radius
  • Font Size
  • FAQ Spacing
  • Open & Close Icons
  • Accordion Animation
  • FAQ Schema
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate to FAQs → Add New.
  4. Create your FAQs.
  5. Display them using the shortcode.
sections.faq:
Can I create unlimited FAQs?

Yes. Create as many FAQs as you need.

Can I organize FAQs into categories?

Yes. The plugin supports FAQ categories.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. It is designed to work with most modern WordPress themes.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes. The accordion is fully responsive.

Does it support FAQ Schema?

Yes. JSON-LD FAQ Schema can be enabled from the settings.

Can I use shortcodes?

Yes.
